newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 15.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 11.95 points at 7,286.16, as profit-taking unraveled early strong gains after a report showed April wholesale prices posted their biggest decline in nearly four years.

* The Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) handed down penalties including fines up to one billion rupiah and administrative sanctions on investors, brokerage houses and the Jakarta Stock Exchange mangement over the Bank Pikko share scam in early April.

* Six people died in traffic accidents during the minority United Development Party (PPP) supporters' convoys on Jakarta streets on Wednesday. There were also sporadic minor clashes with security officers, news reports said.
* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 2.30 points to close at 670.59 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,437.25/37.75 at 0150 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,433.00/34.00.
* Small-sized Bank Pikko on reports the Capital Market Supervisory Agency had handed down penalties on parties involved in the Bank Pikko share scam.
* Tourism firm Bayu Buana following active trading on Wednesday due to market talk of a possible take-over.
* Indosat and Lonsum after announcements of rises in their first quarter results.
* Sorini and Aneka Kimia on renewed market talk of a possible merger.
